pumac-2020-combinatorics-a-07.prompt:
Let $f$ be defined as below for integers $n\ge0$ and $a_0,a_1,\dots$ such that $\sum_{i\ge0}a_i$ is finite:
$$f(n;a_0,a_1,\dots)=\begin{cases}a_{2020}&n=0\\[2pt]\dfrac{\sum_{i\ge0}a_i\,f(n-1;a_0,\dots,a_{i-1},a_i-1,a_{i+1}+1,a_{i+2},\dots)}{\sum_{i\ge0}a_i}&n>0.\end{cases}$$
Find the nearest integer to $f(2020^2;2020,0,0,\dots)$.

pumac-2020-combinatorics-a-08.prompt: Let $f(k)$ denote the number of triples $(a,b,c)$ of positive integers satisfying $a+b+c=2020$ with $(k-1)$ not dividing $a$, $k$ not dividing $b$, and $(k+1)$ not dividing $c$. Find the product of all integers $k$ in the range $3\le k\le20$ such that $(k+1)$ divides $f(k)$.
